title: The $γ_c$-Peak: Covariant Recovery on Four Organic Qubit Platforms
summary: We characterize where, in the noise parameter space of the uniform dephasing--depolarizing channel $\mathcal N_γ^δ=\mathcal E_δ\!\circ\!\mathcal D_γ$, a deterministic, \emph{nonlinear, target-informed} denoising heuristic yields its largest fidelity gain. The procedure pulls the off-diagonal magnitudes of the noisy state toward those of a known target, with efficiency set by a SWAP-test-purified catalyst; it is not a quantum channel, and target access is an explicit classical resource, so the results describe a benchmark procedure, not blind error correction.
